motivation: all seven single-factor probes show no systematic silence effect; interactions were never tested. 132-shape (passive by-agent + event-nominal patient) is the sharpest candidate.
design: 2x2 active/passive x verbal-complement/nominal-theme, 4 scenarios, YES(supports)/NO(stop) mirrors. NO verb is stop (aspectual negative): deny does not license the participial-complement frame, stop does in all four cells.

cells.A: active + verbal complement (The foundation supports teams digitizing records.)
cells.B: active + nominal theme (The foundation supports the digitization of records.)
cells.C: passive + verbal complement (Teams digitizing records are supported by the foundation.)
cells.D: passive + nominal theme (The digitization of records is supported by the foundation.)

gold_target_per_cell: A/C: the team NP; B/D: the full nominal (span diagnostic kept separate from presence)

decision_rule.interaction_support: A/B/C stable while D degrades, reproducing across scenarios
decision_rule.additive_passive: C and D degrade vs A and B
decision_rule.nominal_only: B and D degrade vs A and C
decision_rule.negative_result: no cell effect; interaction excluded for this shape

test_material: built by script; validation + freeze below
